Who works on what among the people who supervise, teach and examine in the Statistics curriculum. The list includes:

1. the members of the [doctoral committee](https://www.dems.unimib.it/en/node/1047) for the Statistics and BIDAB curricula working in statistics and data science;
2. the statisticians of the Department of Economics, Management and Statistics (DEMS) with a permanent or tenure-track position.

Keywords help students find possible supervisors and members of their committees; click a name for a short description and links.

::: {.faculty data-csv="data/faculty.csv"}
[Download the list (CSV)](data/faculty.csv)
:::
